csv_columns: BDA17word,baseScan,rawScan,carry,count,shiftState,stepXbyte,stepYbyte,accelerationByte,xWord,yWord,then all eight words of each queued record in slot order

controls.sequence: make, duplicate make, break; preserve machine between these three steps; fresh state for each sequence

method: Unicorn 2.1.4 runs the unmodified canonical DOS 0747/036E/0445/0CB3 instructions captured read-only after canonical startup; actual linked map resolves globals. Controlled data/CPU register inputs above are set before each sequence. Return carry, source state and every queued Event word are compared without masks or ignored fields. CSV uses decimal integers, comma separators and LF terminators.
scope: Complete 128-index scan matrix for these six incoming modifier words and register/coordinate state, empty descriptor queues and source mouse mode0. Does not establish physical SDL register residue, interrupt scheduling, third-party hook behavior, BIOS translation or mickey-mode equality.
